🚨 TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Whitbourne-Placentia RCMP are responding to multiple vehicles off the road along Route 100. Road conditions in the area are very icy and hazardous.  

Please consider delaying any non-essential travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions. 

A reminder that the Move Over Law requires you to slow down and move over when approaching emergency vehicles, tow trucks, municipal, provincial, federal enforcement vehicles and public utility vehicles. Failing to do so can result in a fine of up to $900 and the loss of 4 demerit points.
